description: Wildlife, mounts, NPC navigation, townsfolk groups and race/NPC showcases

scenes.title: NirnCraft wildlife in view: deer, sabre cat, bear, mudcrab, mammoth
setup: command execute as @p at @p run summon nirncraft:deer ~2 ~ ~
command execute as @p at @p run summon nirncraft:sabre_cat ~3 ~ ~1
command execute as @p at @p run summon nirncraft:bear ~-3 ~ ~2
command execute as @p at @p run summon nirncraft:mudcrab ~1 ~ ~3
command execute as @p at @p run summon nirncraft:mammoth ~5 ~ ~-2
scenes.note: source summons around the player at spawn (seed 1234); fixed to Whiterun plains looking +X; kill selectors run as the server, add "execute as @p at @p run" if distance must be player-relative

scenes.title: Native NPC walks five metres along the Embershard walkway toward the observer
setup: command execute as @p at @p run nirncraft-dev scenario spawn cave-navigation nirncraft:npc -275 89 795 active
command execute as @p at @p run nirncraft-dev scenario move cave-navigation -275 88 800
command execute as @p at @p run nirncraft-dev scenario move cave-navigation -275 88 800
cleanup: command execute as @p at @p run nirncraft-dev scenario cleanup cave-navigation
scenes.note: scenario waits for onGround then goalReached (observe probes, re-issuing move while pending); approximated with fixed waits

scenes.title: Townsfolk group in the Whiterun Plains District market street
setup: command execute as @p at @p run summon nirncraft:npc ^ ^ ^5
command execute as @p at @p run summon nirncraft:npc ^1.5 ^ ^6
command execute as @p at @p run summon nirncraft:npc ^-1.5 ^ ^6
command execute as @p at @p run summon nirncraft:npc ^0.5 ^ ^8
scenes.source: new (owner gap: NPC group in a town street)
scenes.note: market street position guessed from the Cities.whiterun plan; native townsfolk may already populate it, summons guarantee a group (the kill selector is a guess; check it spares the town population)
